t: Flomasta PipeGrip Elbow is a pack of 10 push-fit water pipe connectors that let allows the user to turn 10mm pipework through a clean 90° bend. With a dual locking system and green band indicator, they ensure a secure, leak-free connection without hot works. WRAS approved and compatible with copper or plastic pipe, these pipe elbows are perfect for multiple installations in small plumbing tasks.
